BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.FactTaxiDaily', 'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.FactTaxiDaily (
            date_key int NOT NULL,
            pickup_location_id int NOT NULL,
            trip_count bigint NOT NULL,
            total_amount_usd decimal(28, 2) NULL,
            amount_trip_count bigint NOT NULL,
            distance_sum_miles decimal(28, 4) NULL,
            valid_distance_trip_count bigint NOT NULL,
            duration_sum_seconds bigint NULL,
            valid_duration_trip_count bigint NOT NULL,
            fare_sum_usd decimal(28, 2) NULL,
            fare_trip_count bigint NULL
        );
    END;

    DELETE FROM dbo.FactTaxiDaily;

    WITH prepared_trips AS (
        SELECT
            d.date_key,
            COALESCE(z.location_id, 264) AS pickup_location_id,
            CAST(t.total_amount AS decimal(18, 2)) AS amount_usd,
            CAST(t.fare_amount AS decimal(18, 2)) AS fare_usd,
            CASE WHEN t.has_invalid_distance = 0
                THEN CAST(t.trip_distance AS decimal(18, 4))
            END AS valid_distance_miles,
            CASE WHEN t.has_invalid_duration = 0
                THEN CAST(t.trip_duration_seconds AS bigint)
            END AS valid_duration_seconds
        FROM [lh_silver].[dbo].[taxi_trips] AS t
        LEFT JOIN dbo.DimDate AS d
            ON d.calendar_date = t.pickup_date
        LEFT JOIN dbo.DimZone AS z
            ON z.location_id = t.PULocationID
        WHERE t.is_outside_source_month = 0
    )
    INSERT INTO dbo.FactTaxiDaily (
        date_key, pickup_location_id, trip_count,
        total_amount_usd, amount_trip_count,
        distance_sum_miles, valid_distance_trip_count,
        duration_sum_seconds, valid_duration_trip_count,
        fare_sum_usd, fare_trip_count
    )
    SELECT
        date_key,
        pickup_location_id,
        COUNT_BIG(*),
        SUM(amount_usd),
        COUNT_BIG(amount_usd),
        SUM(valid_distance_miles),
        COUNT_BIG(valid_distance_miles),
        SUM(valid_duration_seconds),
        COUNT_BIG(valid_duration_seconds),
        SUM(fare_usd),
        COUNT_BIG(fare_usd)
    FROM prepared_trips
    GROUP BY date_key, pickup_location_id;

    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

    THROW;
END CATCH;

BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.FactAirQualityDaily', 'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.FactAirQualityDaily (
            date_key int NOT NULL,
            location_id bigint NOT NULL,
            sensor_id bigint NOT NULL,
            pollutant varchar(20) NOT NULL,
            unit varchar(20) NOT NULL,
            daily_mean float NULL,
            coverage_ratio float NULL,
            observed_hours int NULL,
            expected_hours int NULL,
            has_invalid_daily_mean bit NOT NULL,
            source_system varchar(20) NULL,
            sensor_key varchar(80) NULL,
            station_name varchar(150) NULL
        );
    END;

    DELETE FROM dbo.FactAirQualityDaily;

    WITH air_measurements AS (
        SELECT
            a.local_date,
            a.location_id,
            a.sensor_id,
            a.pollutant,
            a.unit,
            a.daily_mean,
            a.coverage_ratio,
            a.observed_hours,
            a.expected_hours,
            a.has_invalid_daily_mean,
            'openaq' AS source_system,
            CONCAT('openaq:', a.sensor_id) AS sensor_key,
            CASE a.sensor_id
                WHEN 673 THEN 'CCNY'
                WHEN 1102 THEN 'Bronx - IS52'
                WHEN 1152 THEN 'Queens'
                ELSE CONCAT('OpenAQ sensor ', a.sensor_id)
            END AS station_name
        FROM [lh_silver].[dbo].[air_quality_daily] AS a

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            e.local_date,
            s.site_id AS location_id,
            s.site_id * 1000 + CAST(e.poc AS bigint) AS sensor_id,
            e.pollutant,
            e.unit,
            e.daily_mean,
            e.coverage_ratio,
            e.observed_hours,
            e.expected_hours,
            e.has_invalid_daily_mean,
            e.source_system,
            CONCAT('epa_aqs:', e.sensor_key),
            e.station_name
        FROM [lh_silver].[dbo].[epa_no2_daily] AS e
        CROSS APPLY (
            SELECT CAST(REPLACE(e.aqs_site_id, '-', '') AS bigint) AS site_id
        ) AS s
    )
    INSERT INTO dbo.FactAirQualityDaily (
        date_key, location_id, sensor_id, pollutant, unit, daily_mean,
        coverage_ratio, observed_hours, expected_hours, has_invalid_daily_mean,
        source_system, sensor_key, station_name
    )
    SELECT
        d.date_key, a.location_id, a.sensor_id, a.pollutant, a.unit, a.daily_mean,
        a.coverage_ratio, a.observed_hours, a.expected_hours, a.has_invalid_daily_mean,
        a.source_system, a.sensor_key, a.station_name
    FROM air_measurements AS a
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DimDate AS d
        ON d.calendar_date = a.local_date;

    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

    THROW;
END CATCH;

BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.DimFX', 'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.DimFX (
            date_key int NOT NULL,
            base_currency varchar(3) NOT NULL,
            quote_currency varchar(3) NOT NULL,
            usd_per_eur decimal(18, 8) NOT NULL,
            rate_source_date date NOT NULL,
            is_carried_forward bit NOT NULL
        );
    END;

    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.DimGDP', 'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.DimGDP (
            country_code varchar(3) NOT NULL,
            country_name varchar(100) NOT NULL,
            indicator_code varchar(32) NOT NULL,
            gdp_year int NOT NULL,
            gdp_usd decimal(20, 2) NULL
        );
    END;

    DELETE FROM dbo.DimFX;

    WITH ranked_rates AS (
        SELECT
            d.date_key,
            d.calendar_date,
            fx.base_currency,
            fx.quote_currency,
            fx.usd_per_eur,
            fx.fx_date AS rate_source_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.date_key
                ORDER BY fx.fx_date DESC
            ) AS rate_rank
        FROM dbo.DimDate AS d
        LEFT JOIN [lh_silver].[dbo].[fx_rates_daily] AS fx
            ON fx.fx_date <= d.calendar_date
            AND fx.base_currency = 'EUR'
            AND fx.quote_currency = 'USD'
    )
    INSERT INTO dbo.DimFX (
        date_key, base_currency, quote_currency, usd_per_eur,
        rate_source_date, is_carried_forward
    )
    SELECT
        date_key,
        base_currency,
        quote_currency,
        usd_per_eur,
        rate_source_date,
        CASE WHEN rate_source_date < calendar_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    FROM ranked_rates
    WHERE rate_rank = 1;

    DELETE FROM dbo.DimGDP;

    INSERT INTO dbo.DimGDP (
        country_code, country_name, indicator_code, gdp_year, gdp_usd
    )
    SELECT country_code, country_name, indicator_code, gdp_year, gdp_usd
    FROM [lh_silver].[dbo].[gdp_annual];

    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

    THROW;
END CATCH;
